metadata.description:
FEDUPP is an open-source analysis pipeline for Feeding Experimentation Device 3 (FED3) behavioral data. It supports fixed-ratio 1 and reversal-learning analyses, including learning curves, meal-pattern metrics, machine-learning meal classification, accuracy distributions, block-transition analyses, win-stay/lose-shift strategies, retrieval times, inter-pellet interval analyses, cross-feature correlations, and export of computed metrics.

This software archive accompanies the Translational Psychiatry article describing FEDUPP and its use for assessing learning and cognitive flexibility in home-cage behavioral experiments.
references: Yao, M., Libster, A. M., Desfor, S. et al. The development of FEDUPP: feeding experimentation device users processing package to assess learning and cognitive flexibility. Translational Psychiatry (2026). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41398-026-04091-6
metadata.notes: This archive was prepared from the GitHub repository https://github.com/ftlabucsd/FED3-data.
